documents.text: Tom Fisher (1900s pitcher) Thomas Chalmers Fisher (November 1, 1880 – September 3, 1972) was a professional baseball pitcher. The 5"10½", . right-hander played one season in Major League Baseball for the Boston Beaneaters in 1904. Fisher made his major league debut in relief on April 17, 1904 against the Brooklyn Superbas at Washington Park. His first major league win came as a starter on May 10 against the Chicago Cubs at West Side Park. The score was 7-1.
